headlines: Over 90% of employment growth to May 2035 is in jobs that usually need a post-school qualification (skill levels 1 to 4).
Services industries account for about 84% of projected employment growth.
Health Care and Social Assistance has the fastest projected industry growth (23% over 10 years).
